commentary: The current rate waterfall shows dramatic compression: H100 spot rates have collapsed to $1.99-2.69/hr (from $3.99+ on-demand), and even H200 spot is trading at $3.59/hr—below where H100 on-demand sat a year ago. Meanwhile, hyperscalers extended AI server depreciation to 5.5-6 years (saving ~$18B annually per estimates), yet Amazon's partial reversal and Burry's $176B understatement claim signal rising skepticism that GPU economics support 6-year lives. CoreWeave's cost of debt fell from 15% to 5.9% investment-grade in 30 months, but July 2026 CDS at 50% default probability suggests credit markets see the GPU refresh treadmill as unsustainable—the waterfall is real, the accounting may not be.
